<documents>
<document id="close-inactivity">
InactiveˆaccountsˆWeˆmayˆcloseˆaccountsˆthatˆhaveˆaˆ$0.00ˆbalanceˆandˆnoˆactivityˆforˆ12ˆmonths.ˆ##ˆNoticeˆWeˆemailˆyouˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆclosing.ˆAnyˆactivityˆduringˆthatˆtime,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆdepositˆorˆaˆcardˆpurchase,ˆkeepsˆtheˆaccountˆopen.ˆ##ˆFeesˆWeˆdon'tˆchargeˆinactivityˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆAccountsˆwithˆmoneyˆinˆthemˆWeˆdon'tˆcloseˆaccountsˆforˆinactivityˆwhileˆtheyˆholdˆaˆbalance,ˆincludingˆmoneyˆinˆSavingsˆPockets.ˆ##ˆPaidˆplansˆAˆpaidˆplanˆkeepsˆchargingˆitsˆmonthlyˆfeeˆwhileˆtheˆaccountˆisˆopen,ˆwhichˆcountsˆasˆactivity.ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆuseˆyourˆaccount,ˆconsiderˆmovingˆtoˆBasic.ˆ##ˆComingˆbackˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆwasˆclosedˆforˆinactivity,ˆyouˆcanˆapplyˆforˆaˆnewˆoneˆwheneverˆyouˆlike.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆanˆaccountˆopenˆAnyˆcardˆpurchase,ˆdepositˆorˆtransferˆcountsˆasˆactivity.ˆSigningˆinˆtoˆtheˆappˆonˆitsˆownˆdoesn't.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="close-how">
HowˆtoˆcloseˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆcloseˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆorˆaskˆsupportˆtoˆcloseˆitˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆcloseˆYourˆaccountˆcanˆonlyˆbeˆclosedˆwhen:ˆ-ˆNoˆtransactionsˆareˆpendingˆ-ˆNoˆdisputesˆareˆopenˆ-ˆYourˆbalanceˆisn'tˆnegativeˆAlsoˆmoveˆmoneyˆoutˆofˆyourˆSavingsˆPocketsˆandˆswitchˆyourˆdirectˆdepositˆandˆanyˆautomaticˆpaymentsˆtoˆanotherˆaccount.ˆ##ˆCloseˆinˆtheˆappˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆCloseˆaccount.ˆTheˆappˆchecksˆtheˆrequirements,ˆshowsˆwhereˆanyˆremainingˆmoneyˆwillˆgo,ˆandˆasksˆyouˆtoˆconfirm.ˆ##ˆClosingˆthroughˆsupportˆSupportˆcanˆcloseˆyourˆaccountˆforˆyouˆwhenˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆ$0.00ˆandˆtheˆrequirementsˆaboveˆareˆmet.ˆIfˆthere'sˆmoneyˆleft,ˆmoveˆitˆoutˆfirstˆorˆcloseˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆwhichˆsendsˆitˆtoˆyou.ˆ##ˆPlanˆfeesˆPlanˆfeesˆaren'tˆrefundedˆorˆproratedˆwhenˆyouˆclose,ˆexceptˆunderˆtheˆcooling-offˆruleˆforˆaˆfirstˆpaidˆplanˆcharge.ˆClosingˆisˆpermanent.ˆAˆclosedˆaccountˆcan'tˆbeˆreopened.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="close-balance">
WhatˆhappensˆtoˆyourˆmoneyˆwhenˆyouˆcloseˆWhenˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccountˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆweˆsendˆanyˆremainingˆmoneyˆtoˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆweˆsendˆitˆ-ˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆaˆlinkedˆexternalˆaccount,ˆweˆsendˆtheˆbalanceˆthereˆbyˆACH.ˆ-ˆIfˆyouˆdon't,ˆweˆmailˆaˆcheckˆtoˆtheˆaddressˆonˆyourˆprofile.ˆEitherˆway,ˆit'sˆsentˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdaysˆofˆclosing.ˆ##ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆMoneyˆinˆyourˆpockets,ˆandˆanyˆinterestˆearnedˆupˆtoˆtheˆclosingˆdate,ˆisˆincludedˆinˆtheˆpayout.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆthatˆarriveˆlaterˆIfˆaˆmerchantˆrefundˆorˆotherˆcreditˆarrivesˆafterˆyourˆaccountˆisˆclosed,ˆweˆsendˆitˆtoˆyouˆtheˆsameˆway.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆcloseˆMakeˆsureˆyourˆaddressˆisˆupˆtoˆdateˆifˆyou'llˆbeˆpaidˆbyˆcheck.ˆChecksˆcan'tˆbeˆsentˆtoˆaˆPOˆbox.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆsendˆitˆsomewhereˆelse?ˆNo.ˆWeˆcanˆonlyˆsendˆyourˆbalanceˆtoˆanˆexternalˆaccountˆinˆyourˆownˆname,ˆorˆbyˆcheckˆtoˆyourˆaddressˆonˆfile.ˆWeˆcan'tˆsendˆitˆtoˆanotherˆperson.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
